values.note: DCNR: 'The 61-site campground accommodates tents, trailers, and motor homes.' The booking site lists 48 Modern Electric and 13 non-electric sites (two walk-to) in the Long, Short and Upper loops, besides 3 camping cottages. Listed max vehicle lengths run 30-45 ft at most electric sites; the non-electric sites are 12-20 ft. One pull-through (031).

summary: Confirmed inherited reservable/ReserveAmerica/11-month window for this park; season (mid-April to mid-December) already manual. Added 50-amp electric, 61 campsites to 45 ft with one pull-through, showers, flush toilets, drinking water, dump. Not stated for this park: water/sewer at sites, min/max stay, noon cutoff, fcfs. Fees left as recorded.
